reviews.author: Jason Chan
reviews.text: Went here with the family on Monday night.  The place wasn't busy had a seat right away.  The restaurant was quite big and spacious.  We order all types of foods.  The staff and services was quite helpful. The foods came pretty quick and it was very tasty.   Would definitely come back here again to try other foods.

reviews.author: Shannon
reviews.text: Jasmine was very attentive and kind! Her drinks were delicious and service was 5 star. The food blatantly speaks for itself. The appetizer we got was the combo with wings, croquettes, quesadillas and mozzarella sticks. We wish we saved more room for the entrees. I got filet mignon that I was able to cut with a butter knife !! My husband got a platter with assorted steak, chicken, sausage, shrimp…

reviews.author: Angela Singh
reviews.text: I came to this restaurant on my birthday with my family and we were treated so well. The service and promptness were amazing. Staff were so friendly and made us feel right at home. The food was delicious and the vibe was great. Thank you!

reviews.author: João Meira
reviews.text: Absolutely delicious! The yuca empanadas arrived with such a nice presentation – almost too pretty to eat! And the lomo de Peru is seriously amazing – incredibly seasoned and juicy. The meat was so tender and flavorful. But the best part was the tres leches – oh my God, it was the perfect ending to the meal! Highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: alissa lobban
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience from start to finish! The food was incredible, the drinks were perfectly made, and the vibes were unmatched. The customer service was so loving and welcoming, making us feel comfortable and appreciated the entire time. The staff was attentive, friendly, and truly made the experience even more enjoyable. Definitely one of the best places to eat, relax, and have a…

reviews.author: abcdan
reviews.text: Stereotypical Cantonese family style restaurant serving wide variety of dishes you know and love. The place inside isn’t too big, so if you have a big party, best call in to book ahead.  All the dishes tasted authentic and wasn’t overly salty or oily for that matter.  The glazed short ribs and the fish maw soup was our favorite!

reviews.author: Christine Le
reviews.text: If you're ordering takeout, be patient as there's only one person manning the front. Dine in is great, dinner meals are always consistent. Bathroom cleanliness is lacking. They only accept cash.

reviews.author: Matt Fong
reviews.text: The food and dim sum are really good authentic Cantonese here. The service is passable; they're not the most friendly but they're not necessarily rude either. The place is slightly dingy, and it is a bit cramped, but you definitely don't come to eat here for the atmosphere.

reviews.author: Carl
reviews.text: It wasn't so crowded on a weekday lunch time. The dim sum was ok. We didn't order dishes, but the fried rice was a little blend. They probably cater to elders more on low sodium meals. The takeout was good! The crispy roasted pork was on point, and the price is very reasonable.

reviews.author: William Chu
reviews.text: This is a nice local authentic Chinese restaurant with great tasting food and big portions. The service was impeccable. Always enjoy having family gatherings in restaurants like these.

reviews.author: Oksana Rich
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the hospitality made us feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious. The fried eggplant salad was outstanding, and the fried potatoes with mushrooms were perfectly cooked and incredibly flavorful. Thank you for such a warm welcome and a fantastic dining experience. We look forward to coming back soon. Highly…

reviews.author: roninportfolio
reviews.text: Fantastic restaurant! We celebrated an 80th birthday with 24 people and the staff were incredible.  Every dish was flavorful and fresh! The salads were mouth watering.  The meat was tasty and tender. Potatoes w mushrooms are so tasty.  The sheep images are interesting.  The size of the restaurant is nice for the size of people we had.  Great food and people.  We will be coming back for our next…

reviews.author: Angelika Akhtiamova
reviews.text:
I recently visited Sheep by Barashka in Brooklyn and really enjoyed the experience. It has a cozy, slightly “home-style” atmosphere with Caucasian/Russian cuisine — very hearty food, generous portions, and you can genuinely feel that everything is made with care.

The dishes were mostly great: the grilled meats were juicy and flavorful, the salads felt fresh, and the hot appetizers and meat…

reviews.author: Angie Clarke
reviews.text: Amazing Russian restaurant 10/10, can’t wait to come back! Our server Roma A was fantastic! We got chicken, beef, lamb and chicken luyla, young lamb ribs, and potatoes, and rice - everything was extremely fresh and tasted amazing, well worth the price. We even received a complimentary dessert!

reviews.author: Irina Garmaeva
reviews.text:
We recently celebrated a 55th anniversary with a group of 35 people, and I just have to share our experience. The food was unbelievably delicious — it’s almost unfair to cook this well! The service was exceptional, too. The staff took such wonderful care of us that we practically rolled out of there afterward.

The musical show and the performers deserve special praise. Their repertoire was…

To top it off, they put 2 mints inside the bag for after we eat. We've tried Dunkn donuts and Burger King in the neighborhood but the workers there are slow(both ways) and…

reviews.author: Bry G

I’ll admit, I was a little skeptical about the area at first, but the food completely won me over—I even came back the very…

On the plus side, the burgers and hot dogs here are usually good, and the delicious cherry limeade drink is the best.

reviews.author: Blake Wolf

My go-to order recommendations are the french toast sticks for breakfast and the chicken tenders, popcorn chicken or cheeseburger with fries for lunch or dinner. Add a Route 44 Vanilla Coke and a Grape Slushie or Chocolate…

Now I get that they have extra costs to cover, paying for the TVs and game…

reviews.author: Joshua Barbour

The customer service was great. A few of the controllers connected to the emulators seem to have seen some better days(which is expected with excessive use), but overall a really cool spot to hang out late at night.
We ordered two smoothies, a breakfast sandwich and a double smash…

reviews.author: Manuel Ortiz II
reviews.text:
El Nuevo Capri Corp #2 is the real deal! If you want authentic Caribbean Spanish food that actually tastes homemade, this is the spot. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection.
The pernil was tender and juicy, the rice was packed with flavor, and the portions are no joke—you’re definitely getting your money’s worth. You can tell this is made with care, not rushed.
No fancy frills…

reviews.text: Every time I come to El Nuevo Capri, I’ve never had an issue. I see some reviewers complaining about price and portions—look at my plate, the portion is amazing. The prices were also very reasonable, especially for the quality and portion sizes. Although it’s a small place, you can truly feel how hard everyone works to make sure guests are happy…

We like the congee with century egg and BBQ pork over rice plus the lunch specials.

Sat outside at one of their tables with my winged lunch buddies.

reviews.author: John Allie
reviews.text: Justinos  Pizzeria is everything you want in a classic NYC slice shop—quick, affordable, and seriously delicious. After a night out on Stone Street, this place hit the spot perfectly. Whether you’re a local or just passing through…

reviews.author: J.A. Wilson
reviews.text: Perfect pizza place for tourists visiting battery park. Everything in the vicinity screams New York, and it's a quiet area, too, compared to the hustle and bustle scene of the financial district. The taste of the pizza was above and beyond, better than any pizza I could buy in my hometown.

reviews.author: Lily Clark
reviews.text: I've had a lot of NYC Pizza in my life, but this place has to be in the top 5. Perfect crust size and crispiness, melty toppings and big servings. You'll pay $5, but it's worth it- especially after a night out.

reviews.author: Mike Reviewed It!

The crust tasted very plain. No flavor.  The restaurant was kind of dirty too. The only saving grace was that the bathroom was spot less. Total 18 dollars for three slices, some with topping and a fountain soda. On the pricey side.

reviews.author: Donna S
reviews.text: Great little pizza joint in the neighborhood. They had a lot of variety for pizzas and the slices are in big portions. Crust is thin and crispy. Staff was super friendly and there wasn’t too long of a wait. The only wait time was when they heat up your pizza slice in the oven. They also have real Hawaiian with ham slices. Will come again!
